name: Quote-to-Order convert (price lock + order-level reprice)
expected: Converted OrderItem.UnitPrice locks final QLI price; order-level Reprice-All is identical to quote (idempotent); no contextDefinition gack; term fields populated.
actual: No gack (place isSuccess=true, errorResponse=[] x3). UnitPrice locks: ActiveDefenseBEC 77080, Powertech 301.75 stable; EndDate=2027-06-14/PTC=1 populated. BUT NET non-idempotent: Powertech NetUnitPrice QLI=301.75 -> convert=256.4875 -> reprice1=218.014375 -> reprice2=157.5154, each x0.85 (PartnerDiscountPercent=15 re-applied); Base_Price__c=185.31221875.
defectStep: Stamp Base_Price and Pre_Partner from Net (step 106) + Partner Discount (steps 87-88)
proposedFix: Order-context partner-discount base must derive from the pre-partner list/base, not from the already-discounted NetUnitPrice. Step 'Stamp Base_Price and Pre_Partner from Net' seeds Base_Price__c FROM net, so each Reprice-All compounds the 15% partner discount. Recompute partner NET from a stable pre-discount base each pass (idempotent), as in SC-3346 PartnerNetPricePosthook.
regression: SC-3346 / reprice contextDef partner double-discount family
notes: Active proc Rev_Mgmt_Default_Pricing_Procedure V21 confirmed (ESV 9QMWC00000025LN4AY IsActive=true). F-07 named criteria: UnitPrice-lock PASS, no-gack PASS, term-fields PASS, 'order reprice identical to quote' FAIL. Force-reprice run headlessly via /connect/rev/sales-transaction/actions/place (Force/Skip) 3x; NET drift reproducible and geometric. defect_provenance cites SC-3308/SC-3371/reprice contextDef; the gack itself did NOT recur (those fixes hold) but the partner-NET non-idempotency does.
verdict_reason: Order-level Reprice-All is not idempotent: partner NetUnitPrice compounds 15% each pass, violating 'order reprice identical to quote'.
